failure_record_partition.unit: failure_reasons rows / failed TAP assertions; mutually exclusive by recorded output form
failure_record_partition.interpretation: Only explicit EOPNOTSUPP rows establish an operation refusal directly. Unexpected ENOENT rows are cascade candidates, not all proven descendants: a subset may instead be independent pathname/errno mismatches. no_command_detail rows cannot be assigned a syscall cause from this report. Other parsed mismatches mix direct and downstream effects.

explicit_EOPNOTSUPP_by_operation.primary_status: direct observed operation refusals; root cause is capability coverage (unimplemented) unless product scope/spec excludes the operation

test_path_family_counts.unit: all failed TAP assertions in the corresponding source test directory; categories overlap by cause and are not additive

focused_observations.evidence: ftruncate returns success, but expected lstat sizes 1234567/567/23456/1 remain 0/1234567/12345/23456; subsequent unlink returns EAGAIN and later create gets EEXIST, a concrete sequence of primary size mismatch followed by dependent residue. Independent fsx reproduction confirms open-handle fstat size stays stale after successful extension.
EOPNOTSUPP rows enumerated above. chmod/00.t shows symlink EOPNOTSUPP followed by chmod/stat/unlink ENOENT for the absent link target.

focused_observations.primary_count: not isolated exactly; family totals in test_path_family_counts
focused_observations.evidence: chown family has 1259 failed assertions in 7/11 files and chmod has 224 in 9/13. Mixture includes missing-object dependencies. Direct examples include chmod/00.t stat expected mode 0222, got 0111; utimensat/06.t expects EACCES but gets 0. Totals must not be read as unique primary permission defects.

focused_observations.primary_count: not isolated exactly; family totals in test_path_family_counts
focused_observations.evidence: rename directory totals 2834 failed assertions (14/25 files), link 232 (9/18). rename/10.t is a 2,099-assertion nested matrix over regular/fifo/block/char/socket/symlink and owner combinations; early EEXIST plus inode mismatches and unsupported object creation contaminate later assertions. Do not equate 2,834 with independent rename defects.

focused_observations.primary_count: 19 assertions expected ENAMETOOLONG (not all share one cause)
focused_observations.evidence: Raw stderr contains 53,248 GNU cut "invalid decreasing range" diagnostics. dirgen_max obtains _PC_PATH_MAX via pjdfstest pathconf then subtracts one and feeds it to cut; the actual FUSE pathconf values were not captured, so the bad argument origin (FUSE pathconf vs script/environment interaction) remains unresolved. Some ENAMETOOLONG expectations instead got ENOENT/EOPNOTSUPP/EEXIST, mixing path behavior with prior missing/unsupported objects.

focused_observations.primary_count: directory total 53 failures in 8/9 files; 17 parsed timestamp-value mismatches
focused_observations.evidence: Requested times commonly remain at mount-time/current timestamps; utimensat/05.t also has ENOENT after symlink creation fails. The Setattr implementation reads only GetSize/GetMode and routes requests without either to Getattr, so atime/mtime flags are not handled in this adapter path. Raw run ends in bailout after utimensat/08; analysis marks utimensat/09 incomplete, consistent with its Y2038 probe but exact bailout attribution is not asserted.

priorities.classification: likely unimplemented timestamp semantics and permission/ownership rules
priorities.evidence: FUSE Setattr ignores atime/mtime; raw utimensat and chmod/chown families; many counts overlap with cascades.

priorities.classification: confirmed collection DELETE/setup incompatibility; original MKCOL 405 is secondary
priorities.evidence: baseline DELETE /litmus/ returns 409 because non-empty, then MKCOL existing path returns 405. RFC 4918 9.3.1 says 405 for MKCOL is only on mapped URL; 9.6.1 requires collection DELETE to act recursively. Fresh isolated Litmus run begins successfully, then shows COPY/MOVE failures; details in litmus-isolated-repro/.

constraints: This report changes no Core, daemon, adapter, or upstream suite implementation/source. New files are analysis metadata and isolated reproduction evidence only.

observed_errno_subsets.meaning: Failures expecting EPERM/EACCES (including accepted errno alternatives) that report success; direct permission-check mismatches, though an unsupported test object can still be a contributing setup condition.
observed_errno_subsets.meaning_rename_link: Observed mismatch records for rename/link commands outside the ENOENT dependency-candidate and EOPNOTSUPP buckets; not all are independent root causes.
observed_errno_subsets.meaning_path: Observed path-length errno mismatches, with several test setup or unsupported-object alternatives in the same records.
